news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹5.74 (vs ₹229 loss in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹5.74 (up from ₹229 loss in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹196.6m (up 83% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹2.24m (up ₹91.6m from FY 2025). Profit margin: 1.1% (up from net loss in FY 2025). The move to profitability was primarily driven by higher revenue. Over the last 3 years on average, the company's share price growth rate has exceeded its earnings growth rate by 65 percentage points per year, which is a significant difference in performance.

news.title: New major risk - Negative shareholders equity
news.body: The company has negative equity. Total equity: -₹75m This is considered a major risk. Being in negative equity means that the company's liabilities exceed its assets, meaning it owes more to creditors than it has in owned assets. While this doesn't mean the company is about to collapse, in the long-term, this is unsustainable. The company may have issues meeting financial obligations, is at risk of becoming insolvent and may have difficulty raising capital, especially more debt, if needed. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risks Shares are highly illiquid. Negative equity (-₹75m). Earnings have declined by 71% per year over the past 5 years.
